name: @orbit/react
author: Layera Labs
//exports: `./styles.css` was promised here and pointed at `dist/styles.css`, which the build has never emitted — this package contains no .css file at all. Following the docs got you ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND. Removed rather than stubbed: an empty stylesheet is a worse lie than an absent one.
//dependencies: @orbit/assets was declared here and imported by nothing in src (0 hits); it survived only in the rollup `external` list. Publishing @orbit/react with it would have forced @orbit/assets onto the registry to satisfy an install that never uses it.
//publishConfig: REGISTRY AND ACCESS ARE NOT DECIDED YET, so publishConfig is deliberately absent rather than guessed. Public npm needs {"access":"public"} (a scoped package defaults to restricted and the publish fails without it). GitHub Packages needs {"registry":"https://npm.pkg.github.com"} and the @orbit scope would have to become @layera-labs. Add exactly one of those here before the first publish.
